steps.name: publish
argv:
# EVERY FILE IS NAMED IN FULL, not matched by a glob -- both halves of that
# are scars this repo has already paid for. A glob that misses publishes
# nothing while returning a code that reads like a fetch failure, and
# box_enqueue.output_path_problems refuses a spec whose declared artifacts
# are never named by any step, which a wildcard defeats. Missing ONE file
# is a FAIL of this job, not a partial success.
import hashlib, os, shutil
from_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b15-macplate-publish-0819-out"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b15-macplate-publish-0819"
NAMES = [
    "15-good-listener-mac-plate-r1s1.png",
    "15-good-listener-mac-plate-r1s1.yaml",
    "15-good-listener-mac-plate-r2s1.png",
    "15-good-listener-mac-plate-r2s1.yaml",
]
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
lines = []
for name in NAMES:
    src = os.path.join(from_dir, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        raise SystemExit("!! missing %s -- publishing nothing." % name)
    shutil.copy2(src, dst)
    with open(os.path.join(dst, name), "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + name)
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b15-macplate-publish-0819.sha256"),
          "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(NAMES), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0)
